notes.content:
This is a small fix for d-pad controls using Steam Controller and Xbox 360 controllers on Linux. The fix should resolve any issues players had with their d-pad controls working in these configurations. If you still experience any issues, please let me know!

- Dan

notes.title: Insignificant Patch 1.14 Released
notes.content:
For this patch, I've included balance changes to the damage calculation formula in order to give player stats more weight.

An unintended bug was causing player damage to be capped depending on a player's level. This cap should only apply to enemy damage to help reduce scenarios where players are killed in one hit.

As a result, players will now have the potential to deal much more damage with their attacks when their Physical or Magic attack stats are higher than the enemy's physical or magic defense.

I have also adjusted the damage scaling to help low level players figure out this system and reduce previously strict offense requirements. Now, the lower your level is, the greater impact a small difference in stats will have. For instance, adding one additional point of Intelligence at level one will now most likely result in additional damage done, whereas before several points were required before damage was increased by even a single extra point.

I hope that these changes help point players in the right direction about which of their attacks are effective against which enemies, and make collecting equipment upgrades more fun and rewarding!

- Dan

notes.title: Patch 1.13
notes.content:
Just a small patch that fixes a bug players may have encountered when attempting to start a new game plus.

Before, the game would get stuck right before beginning a new game plus, and now that should no longer be the case.

notes.title: Insignificant Patch 1.12 Released
notes.content:
Version 1.12 of Insignificant is now available, with bug fixes and requested features to help players enjoy the game!

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[b]Mouse Sensitivity controls [/b]- Press the minus or plus keys on a keyboard to adjust your mouse's sensitivity. This will also raise and lower the sensitivity of the camera on a game pad. These controls have been added to the Compendium.

[b]Dual Monitor Setup[/b] - I had a report of the game not working correctly with dual monitors. I have adjusted the game to basically ignore any non main monitors, and tested it with an extra screen I was able to find. Hopefully this helps your setup if you were having issues.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The lake area was causing the game to crash due to an NPC which was not setup properly. This has been fixed.
[*] There was a similar issue with the Onion Mountain area, which has also been fixed.
[*] I manually tested every other area in the game just to be safe and they were all working correctly.
[*] Pop-up dialogue windows were not displaying text fast enough. They have been adjusted to improve readability all around.
[*] Fixed an instance in which touching an ORB would not finish its associated events.
[/list]

I sincerely apologize for any inconvenience these issues may have caused, and appreciate all of your help in bringing them to my attention. If you have any additional issues, please feel free to contact me at [url=https://significantgames.com/contact]significantgames.com/contact[/url] and I would be glad to assist you.

- Dan
